text:
Alex: Kicking off soft-swap for ff/safe_swap_v2 within the change window. Ramp plan: 0 → 1% → 5% → 20% → 100%. Pinning v2 to revision=2026-03-21-rc, canary first.

DeployBot: Initiating feature toggle for ff/safe_swap_v2 to 1% (canary route). Command executed:
```/deploybot toggle ff/safe_swap_v2 --percent 1 --pin revision=2026-03-21-rc```

Jamie: I'll monitor p95 latency and error rate for the next 10m. Alerts I care about: p95 latency > 200ms OR error rate > 0.5%.

SRE_Oncall: Oncall prepping dashboard slice and trace sampling. If any anomaly, post to #incidents and we revert to 0% immediately.

Maria: :thumbsup: Can we keep a 30m quiet window between major steps? also flag note: sticky sessions may need drain handling.

Tony: Added a brief drain plan for nodes on the new route: `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then wait 60s healthcheck. Rollback procedure will: set flag to 0% and unpin revision.

Priya: Release notes updated in the repo: "safe swap routing v2 - staged rollout". Included rollback steps and dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd (internal).

Alex: DeployBot reports toggle succeeded to 1% (1767777785). Monitoring window started.

Jamie: After 10m: p95 latency +10ms (expected), errors 0.02%. Looks healthy -> OK to move to 5% after another 10m observation.

Alex: Proceeding to 5% now. Running: `/deploybot toggle ff/safe_swap_v2 --percent 5`

DeployBot: Toggle to 5% succeeded (1767778400). Safety note: manual rollback command -> `/deploybot toggle ff/safe_swap_v2 --percent 0`.

SRE_Oncall: Copy. I'll escalate and roll back if errors > 0.5% sustained for 3 consecutive 1m windows. Also enabling extra alerting on request admission failures.

Maria: Heads-up: remember to unpin older revision after we hit 100% stable, and update the rollout notes in the console.

Tony: Adding temporary ingress rate-limit on the new route to 200r/s to limit blast radius while ramping.

Alex: :eyes: tagging @product-ops and engineering managers for visibility. Continuing watch and will post another update at 20% step.
